confirmedDefect: When a real matching OperativeProvisionView exists (view is truthy) but view.currentText is null (the CONFLICTED/PARTIAL/REVIEW_REQUIRED cases buildProvisionView deliberately nulls), the entire branch is skipped and the function falls through to the raw base-document path, which computes supersessionStatus purely from getNodeSupersessionStatus (physical-node history) with zero knowledge that a real, unresolved OperativeProvisionView existed for this section. getNodeSupersessionStatus can correctly report CURRENT_OPERATIVE for a physical node no amendment has yet actually superseded - which is true and correct for THAT question, but wrong to treat as confirming the section's operative state is safe when a competing signed-but-not-yet-effective amendment makes that state genuinely CONFLICTED.
